expected_output.scan_summary: Scanned 24 policy-futures stems (24 scoreable). Stems with |z| >= 0.0 per metric: implied_rate_level=24, implied_rate_change=24, volume_level=24, open_interest_level=24. Showing top 3 per metric (12 rows). as_of 2026-04-07.

results.methodology_disclosure: Universe-wide policy-futures strip scan across curve_families=[SOFR_FUT,EUR_SHORT_RATE_FUT,SONIA_FUT], strip_positions 1..8. Ranks each (curve_family, strip_position) stem by absolute z-score across four metrics: implied_rate_level (z on the implied-rate PERCENT series), implied_rate_change (z on the 1-day Δ implied-rate BPS series, Δ × 100), volume_level (z on the raw volume CONTRACTS series), open_interest_level (z on the raw OI CONTRACTS series). Z-score lookback = 252 trading days. Underlying short-rate regime varies across rows: SOFR_FUT=RFR, EUR_SHORT_RATE_FUT=IBOR, SONIA_FUT=RFR (RFR = compounded daily risk-free rate; IBOR = unsecured 3M term IBOR). The implied-rate conversion is metadata-driven from instrument_master.attributes->>'inverse_pricing': implied_rate_pct = 100 - raw_price for inverse-priced strips (all V1 entries), implied_rate_pct = raw_price otherwise. Rolling-generic strip — the per-contract underlying rolls quarterly so each strip slot mixes contracts across rolls; this is the canonical desk read but does NOT equal the price of a single underlying contract over time. This is NOT a tenor-anchored OIS scan, NOT a pack-average summary, NOT a curve-shape read (use futures_calendar_spread / futures_butterfly_simple / futures_cross_market_spread for those), NOT a meeting-by-meeting policy-path decomposition, NOT a CTD-of-futures-of-OIS read (Phase-4 work gated on the CTD identification + OIS-curve interpolation stack per ADR 0011). This is a morning screen, NOT a tactical trade signal.
